bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_LIVE_DIAG_READONLY\n'
printf 'HOST_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'HOST_STATUS='; git status --porcelain | wc -l
printf 'POLL_CONTAINERS\n'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'video|creator|sticker|gserver' || true
printf 'POLL_ALL\n'; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'video|creator|sticker' || true
printf 'REPO_CHECKOUTS\n'; find /home/gace/Project/Gserver -maxdepth 5 -name .git -print 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'video|creator' | head -10 || true
printf 'POLL_SERVICES\n'; systemctl list-units --all --no-legend --no-pager | grep -Ei 'video|creator' | head -15 || true
printf 'RECENT_POLL_LOGS\n'; for c in $(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'video|creator' | head -2); do printf 'CONTAINER=%s\n' "$c"; docker logs --tail 35 --since 45m "$c" 2>&1 | sed -E 's/[0-9]{8,}/[ID]/g' | tail -35; done
